config.notes: RMIT course pages (www.rmit.edu.au/study-with-us/levels-of-study/...) are plain HTML with no page-data JSON. The at-a-glance panel prints both views: "Student type: Domestic International", then the domestic panel (Learning mode / Entry score / Duration / Fees / Next intake / Location), then the international panel in the same order. Every pattern is anchored on the SECOND "Learning mode:" after "Student type: Domestic International", i.e. the international panel. Fee = international "Fees: AU$NN,NNN (YYYY annual)" only; vocational "(YYYY total indicative)" amounts are not read. Intakes = international "Next intake:" months (research shows "Continuous", not read). IELTS = "IELTS (Academic): minimum overall band of X" in the English language requirements section. Central: English https://www.rmit.edu.au/study-with-us/international-students/apply-to-rmit-international-students/entry-requirements/english-requirements/english-language-proficiency-tests ; key dates https://www.rmit.edu.au/students/my-course/important-dates/2026/he and /2027/he (course pages print months directly, so no term_months).
